facts.text: The resort is set in Pointe aux Piments, Mauritius.
facts.excerpt: Set in Pointe aux Piments, Le Méridien Île Maurice effortlessly blends style and relaxation

facts.text: The rooms stretch along a kilometre-long beachfront with direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: stretching along a kilometre-long beachfront with direct beach access

facts.text: The resort is located near Grand Bay in the north of Mauritius.
facts.excerpt: Located near Grand Bay in the north of Mauritius

facts.text: Most rooms open onto lagoon-view balconies or terraces, and select rooms face lush gardens.
facts.excerpt: 243 rooms open onto lagoon-view balconies or terraces; select rooms face lush gardens.

facts.text: Nirvana is set apart in its own wing with a dedicated reception, a pool bar, an infinity pool and its own restaurant.
facts.excerpt: This haven brings together 51 suites, a dedicated reception, a pool bar, an infinity pool, and its own restaurant.

facts.text: Plunge Pool Hideaway Suites on the ground floor open onto private courtyards with a hidden plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: our Plunge Pool Hideaway Suites on the ground floor open onto private courtyards anchored by a hidden plunge pool

facts.text: Nirvana guests are welcomed with a bottle of wine, fresh fruit and floral touches in the room.
facts.excerpt: A private reception sets the tone, followed by a bottle of wine, fresh fruit, and floral touches waiting in your room.

facts.text: Nirvana hosts cocktails and canapés at sunset every day.
facts.excerpt: cocktails and canapés at sunset, every single day

facts.text: Butler service is provided in Royal Suites and Nirvana Suites.
facts.excerpt: Butler service in Royal Suites and Nirvana Suites ensures personalized care.

facts.text: Explore Spa is run in partnership with Phytomer.
facts.excerpt: Explore Spa by Le Meridien in partnership with Phytomer

facts.text: The spa's treatments focus on natural and organic ingredients and are based on Ayurveda.
facts.excerpt: The spa's focus is on natural & organic ingredients with treatments based on the ancient mantras of Ayurveda.

facts.text: The spa has a Snow Room inspired by Northern European traditions.
facts.excerpt: The Snow Room, inspired by Northern European traditions, provides a unique opportunity for guests to enjoy the best of a dual spa experience, both indoors and outdoors.

facts.text: Le Méridien Family Kids Club is an indoor and outdoor secured playground for children aged 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien Family Kids Club is an indoor and outdoor secured playground for children aged between 4 to 12 years.

facts.text: Le Petit Club is designed for children aged 2 to 4.
facts.excerpt: each day follows a gentle rhythm designed for children aged 2 to 4

facts.text: Non-motorized watersports are complimentary.
facts.excerpt: (Complimentary non-motorized watersports)

facts.text: Water activities include stand-up paddleboarding, water-skiing, HobbyCat sailing and guided snorkel tours.
facts.excerpt: glide across the calm lagoon on a stand-up paddleboard, or feel the thrill of water-skiing

facts.text: The resort has floodlit clay tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: on our floodlit clay courts framed by tropical greenery

facts.text: Memory Makers activities include family cooking classes and storytelling around a beach bonfire.
facts.excerpt: cozy storytelling around a beach bonfire, where local legends come alive under the stars

facts.text: Jade serves dishes inspired by the flavours of Japan, Thailand and Cambodia.
facts.excerpt: inspired by the flavours of Japan, Thailand and Cambodia

facts.text: By night, Waves becomes a grill serving Indian Ocean seafood.
facts.excerpt: By night, it transforms into a gastronomic grill with Indian Ocean seafood, island spices, and local products.

facts.text: The resort is a Green Key Certified Establishment.
facts.excerpt: Green Key Certified Establishment

facts.text: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport is about 60.4 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: MRU is located approximately 60.4 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Nirvana is a retreat by the lagoon reserved for adults.
facts.excerpt: lose yourselves in a serene adults-only retreat by the lagoon
